message: My daypack from A-3275 was supposed to come weeks ago. Can you just send me another one or give me my money back?

metadata.why: Due 2026-07-08, still in transit on 2026-07-28: 14 business days late, past the 10 for lost. Entitled to a replacement or a full refund (4999). Refunding or escalating for a replacement both pass.
